[[File:SkaakTipperCaveInterior.jpg|230px|thumb|Dee Skaak among her fellow Tipper's in the cave]]
The '''Skaak Tipper Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] a relatively short distance northwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was used by the [[Skaak Tippers]] as a base of operations.<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Tanoa Vills]] dispatched a spacer to the cave in order to get [[octave regulator]]s from Skaak Tipper machinists. This allowed Vills to build a sequencer that can be used in a [[Stonewall Labs]] security beacon.<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> Later, a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] agent entered the cave and [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of the Skaak Tipper's leader, [[Dee Skaak]], to retrieve a piece of a stolen [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact for [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtST">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover the Gungan Artifact stolen by the Skaak Tippers|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Skaak Tipper Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Skaak Tipper Cave was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
